summary: The register lists a 1926 iron lookout on Burrill Hill in Lynn Woods and says it was last used in the late 1960s; a WPA stone tower built 1935-36 stands on the same hill in the city park.

facts.design: 70-foot iron tower (register); later WPA stone tower, about 48 feet tall
facts.status_note: The register does not say whether the 1926 iron tower survives; a WPA stone tower stands on Burrill Hill, and the sources do not say whether it is on the same spot

staffing.status: Staffed by the state as part of the forest fire detection system
staffing.as_of: not dated in the register; the iron tower was last used in the late 1960s

access.note: Stone tower stands in the municipal Lynn Woods forest park, which has trails; no current source says whether the tower itself is open to climb

visit.trail_note: Trails link the stone tower with Dungeon Rock and other sites, including Great Frog Boulder and Balanced Boulder

notes_for_editor: Conflict unresolved: the register dates a 70-foot iron tower on Burrill Hill to 1926, while the Friends of Lynn Woods flyer says Burrill Hill's earlier towers were wooden and that the first steel tower went up on Mount Gilead in 1929. Register spells the hill 'Burill'. The register gives only a last-use date (late 1960s), so the iron tower's status is recorded as unknown; the standing WPA stone tower on the same hill is not the 1926 structure as far as sources show, and the sources do not say whether the two sit on the same spot. Current open or closed status of the stone tower was not found; the flyer (2008-09) expected reopening and axeleratio's page is undated. Living New Deal and North of Boston listing pages returned 403/404. Facebook posts by FFLAMASS could not be read and are not cited. Staffing dates rest on one register sentence.
